description: Discover deployed Stacks contracts conforming to a trait (e.g. "sip-010", "sip-009", "sip-013"). The discovery endpoint for "which contracts implement X". Reads are public.

conformance.description: declared = parsed from source, inferred = ABI shape-match, any = either (default)

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a prior response's next_cursor

include.description: Set to "abi" to include each contract's full ABI

name: contracts_find
